DialogWelcomeText.message: Welcome to action scheduling! This works the same but better than the old way of just running actions with a delay. Your actions will be saved and available any time you open an instagram tab, they won't disappear if your browser crashes or you navigate the page. Just keep an Instagram tab open and your actions will run on schedule. You can view and manage everything in the Actions Queue tab.

WizardStep1Hint.message: Run Now runs the first action immediately and spaces the rest using your wait time in Settings (including randomization if enabled). Schedule Actions opens the full scheduling options.

WizardTimeWindowHeading.message: Actions will run between these times every day:

WizardTimeWindowHint.message: This is to simulate a human being who sleeps and doesn't do actions on IG 24/7. Actions will be evenly distributed thru this period to give the most delay. If there are too many actions to meet your minimum delay, they will move to the next day and so on.
